title: Localization of a product at a factor prime
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, let $(R_i)_{i\in I}$ be commutative rings, fix $i\in I$ and a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset R_i$, and write $R=\prod_{j\in I}R_j$ with evaluation $\pi_i:R\to R_i$. Then evaluation induces an isomorphism of local rings $R_{\pi_i^{-1}(\mathfrak q)}\simeq(R_i)_{\mathfrak q}$, with both localizations taken at the displayed primes [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].
